newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PRICE RALLY IN BANKING SHARES CONTINUES.
newsitem.headline: PRICE RALLY IN BANKING SHARES CONTINUES.

text.p: * Morning trade was 22 million kroons on Thursday on the
Tallinn bourse.
* Forekspank was the most active stock with 6.7
million kroons traded to be higher at 196.5/197.5 kroons
compared to 193 kroons.
* Hansapank was higher at 149/150 kroons versus
146 kroons in trade of over three million kroons.
* Hoiupank was higher at 149/150 kroons versus
146 kroons with turnover over two million kroons.
* Dealers said banking shares have been moving up as the
market is waiting for their 1997 profit revisions, but the
price rally starting to stop after the first trading hour.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
The price rally in banking
shares continued on the Tallinn bourse on Thursday morning but
dealers said it is slowing and closing prices are expected to
come slightly down.
Dealers said a correction was expected during the day as
there is little demand at such high prices.
Forekspank was traded higher at 196.5/197.5 kroons compared
to 193 kroons. Hansapank and Hoiupank were both traded higher
at 149/150 kroons versus 146 kroons.
Dealers said the market is waiting for the banks' 1997
profit revisions.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
